[Post-Chorus]

[Chorus]
Tomorrow feels like 自由だ
風に乗って飛んでいくような気分だ
指先で輝く可能性たち

pkg.sunoStyle:
Modern Japanese J-POP, soft groove, spacious clean mix, calm and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Natural call-and-response, alternating lines, gentle harmonies, intimate and expressive vocals. Keep vocals clear and forward.
Minimal intro with soft harmony and subtle ambience. Sparse verses with light rhythm, gentle percussion, and restrained bass. Pre-chorus builds tension through delicate textures and subtle movement, not volume.
Chorus gently opens wider with warm bass, airy harmonies, and light rhythm. Emotional lift but restrained, spacious, and never explosive.
Final section strips back to soft duet vocals and ambience, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean production.
Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers, EDM drops, and aggressive instrumentation.
Song emotion: soft morning uplift, hopeful flight into a bright new day, gentle dawn freedom and warm sunrise glow, airy and restrained.
